items.title: O'Reilly Automotive (ORLY) Stock May Be Above Fair Value On Cash Flow
items.summary: O'Reilly Automotive has delivered a 112.6% total return over the past 5 years, which puts a lot of weight on the question of whether the current US$91.56 share price lines up with the cash the business can generate. With that kind of track record behind it and a recent 1 year pullback, the key issue now is what the underlying cash flows say about today's valuation. The 112.6% gain over 5 years means long term holders are sitting on sizeable profits. Any fresh investment case now rests...
